paragraphs.text: Squeakers is a mousefolk who traveled to Thunder Junction between 4562 and 4563 AR, where they have a bounty outstanding.

Squeakers is a renowned outlaw on Thunder Junction with an affinity for bold solo efforts and an ability to operate effectively on their terms. A mousefolk with white fur and blonde hair, they stand out in their Slickshot Gang attire. They wear elaborate frilled and fan-shaped coattails and collars, characteristic of the Slickshots' fashionable style. Squeakers' last seen actions were flinging half-scissors, a dazzling display of acrobatic skill as they carried away a bag of stolen money. Their nimble movements and swift escape make them a challenging target for capture. Their reputation as a high-profile criminal is cemented by their ability to execute daring crimes and evade capture, which has put a bounty on their back.
